title: Speaker-Composition Sensitivity of Frozen-Embedding Dialect Distance
description: Code, sanitized pair manifests, an author-defined binary reference, tests, and aggregate report-level outputs for an IEEE Signal Processing Letters study of speaker-composition sensitivity in frozen speech-embedding dialect distance. The manuscript, paper PDFs, and LaTeX or TikZ sources are not included. The MIT license covers this project material only; third-party Sinitic_Data matrices are not included and must be rebuilt from the pinned upstream commit under its provider terms.
